newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX touches new closing high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX touches new closing high.

text.p: Austria's ATX closed 0.44 percent up on Thursday, extending its rally into record territory. Traders forecast a period of consolidation after recent heady gains.
* ATX up 6.84 points, or 0.44 pct, at 1,480.49. Earlier it touched 1,485.69 -- the highest levels since the index was recalculated in January 1991.
* Top gainer viscose fibre maker Lenzing up 6.69 pct at a year-high of 941 ats. Traders said price and liquidity boosted by news firm expects to turn a profit in 1998.
* Leading loser Creditanstalt ordinaries, down 0.76 pct at 913 ats.
* August ATX future up 2.6 points at 1,481.6
* Broad-based Vienna bourse index up 2.62 points, or 0.5 pct, at 528.47.
